'''Droideka Delta''' was a member of [[IG-88's Droid Army]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was part of a radical group of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that would have started a [[Droid Revolution]] had they not been destroyed in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].
